message.content: No, there is no information provided suggesting that Li Hua asked Wolfgang for advice on renovating the basement before inviting Adam Smith to check the progress. In contrast, the renovation discussions appear to involve Li Hua and Adam Smith directly. Adam Smith mentions coordinating with a repair service for necessary repairs, and Li Hua discusses the inconvenience of the renovations with Adam Smith, noting that they hope to minimize disruptions.
